description: Attach an existing object to a transport task, so it travels with that request. The way back from RemoveTransportObject, which leaves the object in no request at all. Refused when another task holds the object, with SCTS_ADT_MSG 009 naming the holder — that refusal is the server's answer, read it rather than pre-checking. A 200 says the request was understood; confirm with ReadTransportObjects.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

object_type.description: Object-directory type — CLAS, FUGR, TABL, DOMA — not an ADT type code like CLAS/OC.

pgmid.description: Program id. Defaults to R3TR, a workbench object's.

transport_number.description: The TASK to attach the object to, e.g. E19K905943 — the one call where a task number is the point of the call rather than an afterthought. An object is created on a REQUEST and moved onto a task here; a request number attaches nothing, because a request holds objects only through its tasks.

name: AddTransportObject
